Subject: Sponsor alignment, MAP draft, and EB timebox proposal

Hi Samir —

Great speaking yesterday. To keep momentum for the eval and boardroom conversation, I pulled together a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a proposed executive board (EB) timebox so we can lock dates and owners. High level asks:

- Confirm the primary exec sponsor from Acme and a backup (name + email)
- Agree on the MAP milestones and owners (we've suggested owners in the attached spreadsheet)
- Pick 2 potential EB 60-minute slots in the week of June 12–16

I attached the MAP draft and an EB timebox PDF with suggested agenda and roles. Proposed next steps: you confirm sponsor and availability, we finalize the MAP and send calendar invites (we'll include a brief prep deck).

If easier, here's a quick hubspot link to the deal: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2025-0897

Thanks — looking forward to firming this up.

Best,
Ava Chen

Ava —

Thanks, this looks helpful. Quick answers:
- Primary exec sponsor: Laura Jenkins (VP, Product) — laura.jenkins@acme.com
- Backup: Ravi Patel (CIO) — I'll confirm if Ravi will be the backup or if we keep Laura + another director.

For EB timing, June 13 afternoon or June 15 morning work best for Laura. June 14 is a no-go (all-hands).

Also: can you share a version of the MAP with owners assigned to Acme stakeholders (makes it easier for us to route internally)?

—Samir
